newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Sydney wheat futures rise on U.S. sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Sydney wheat futures rise on U.S. sentiment.

text.p: Wheat futures edged higher in light volume on the Sydney Futures Exchange on Tuesday, rising on the back of overnight gains in nearby U.S. wheat, traders said.
March and May were the big gainers, each rising A$2.50 a tonne to A$165.00 and A$167.00 a tonne, respectively.
Local contracts were buoyed by bullish market sentiment in the U.S. in reaction to USDA quarterly wheat stockpile figures perceived as favoring sellers.
The report placed the U.S. wheat supply at 1.724 billion bushels, below an average analysts tally of 1.767 billion bushels.
Traders said light volume trading limited price gains.
Some traders down-played the impact of the USDA data, maintaining that a shortage of trades suggested prices would generally trade lower at some point.
